data.gender_notes: Shaina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Sha'anit', meaning 'Given by God'. This name appears in the Hebrew Bible and is associated with the prophetess Hannah. The name Shaina carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shaina usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Shaina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shaina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
